confidence_notes: June city price-index averages anchor meals and draft beer; coffee varies across small datasets. comparable_city_reasoning: Cluj-Napoca’s university, IT and event demand suggests room prices near Bucharest and above Sibiu. Estimates place three-star rooms just below Bucharest’s supplied average, basic rooms slightly above it, and hostels modestly above Bucharest.
